newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's says 1994 underwriting profit 1.005 bln stg.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's says 1994 underwriting profit 1.005 bln stg.

text.p: Lloyd's of London on Wednesday announced a preliminary profit for its 1994 underwriting year of 1.005 billion pounds before tax and after personal expenses.
The figure was slightly lower than 1993's profit of 1,084 million pounds.

The preliminary result is based on an initial review of syndicate returns representing 94 per cent of the market's 1994 capacity of 10.898 billion pounds ($18 billion) and projections for the remaining syndicates.
Final figures for the 1994 year will be published in Lloyd's Global Results 1996 in early June when projected results for the 1995 and 1996 years of account will also be published.

Lloyd's Global Results 1995 projected a profit for the 1994 underwriting year of 1.008 billion, using an exchange rate of $1.55. The preliminary result of 1.005 billion pounds is based on the exchange rate at 31 December 1996 of $1.71.
